segments.he: וְיִהְיוּ גְּדֵלִים מֵהֶם פֵּרוֹת טוֹבִים וְנִפְלָאִים מְאד. גַּם אָמַר שֶׁיּוֹצְאֵי חֲלָצָיו לָקַח מֵעוֹלָם הָאֲצִילוּת:
segments.en: (3.) I heard a witticism in the name of Rabbainu o.b.m.: "From the day the Tsar of Russia conquered the land — money and silver became dross, and drink became pansh [adulterated]." [A reference to the verse in Isaiah 1]: "Your silver has become dross — your wine is diluted with water." And understand.
